intent: Write JUnit 5 + AssertJ (Mockito / StepVerifier where reactive) tests for TelemetrySample, asserting only against ast_hints. Unit: Context Telemetry Stream Intake. Immutable record TelemetrySample(UUID recordId, String deviceId, MetricType metricType, double value, Instant deviceTimestamp, Instant ingressTimestamp, ValidationStatus validationStatus). Nested enums MetricType{HEART_RATE,POWER,CADENCE,GROUND_CONTACT_TIME,RESPIRATION,SWIM_STROKE,SWIM_PACE} and ValidationStatus{VALID,VALIDATION_FAILED}. Invariants: deviceId non-blank, all other fields non-null; t_device is the ordering authority, t_ingress never used for ordering; a failed sample keeps its payload. recordId identity is deterministic: UUID.nameUUIDFromBytes of deviceId|metricType|deviceTimestamp (static recordIdFor). withStatus returns a copy with the new status.

methods.signature: static UUID recordIdFor(String deviceId, TelemetrySample.MetricType metricType, Instant deviceTimestamp)
